title: Place value and powers of ten

explanation.default: Our number system groups digits by powers of ten. A base such as 100 or 1000 is just a clean power of ten that makes mental regrouping easier.
explanation.beginner: 100 means 1 hundred. Numbers near 100 are easier to compare to that landmark.
explanation.intermediate: Bases 100, 1000, and 10000 are powers of ten used as convenient landmarks.
explanation.advanced: Working relative to 10^n is the same algebra as expanding (10^n ± d).

source_references.title: Fundamentals & Applications of Vedic Mathematics (2014)
